responsibility: This file implements mc’s preserved-comment subsystem. It stores comment text and classification state, decides whether a lexical comment is in-body or after-statement based on surrounding whitespace, recognizes procedure heading comments by matching the first word against a procedure name, and enforces one-time retrieval semantics when comments are attached to declarations or statements. It is the comment metadata store consumed by mcLexBuf and decl.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation core for the mcComment stem: it defines commentType/commentDesc storage, classifies procedure/body/after comments, and enforces one-time retrieval, whereas the same-named .def file only declares the Modula-2 API and the .h file exposes just the minimal C lexer hooks.
